_comment: Demo library plan (Phase 4). 'target' is how many clips to keep per collection after review. Search terms favour landscapes, water, weather and cities at night: subjects that rarely show identifiable faces or brands. Every candidate is still reviewed by a person before download (scripts/library.py review). Titles shown on the site are invented at the seed step.

collections.title: Coastlines
collections.description: Shorelines, tides and harbours, mostly at the edges of the day.

collections.title: After dark
collections.description: Cities, roads and rail after sunset, mostly timelapse.

collections.title: Slow water
collections.description: Moss, streams, lakes and still pools.

collections.title: Weather
collections.description: Rain, fog, storms and the sky changing its mind.

collections.title: From orbit
collections.description: The Earth from orbit. Public-domain footage (mostly NASA) via Wikimedia Commons.
